name: Canyon_Strata_Visuals
description: The visible rock layers in the canyon walls — color, texture, and stratification patterns that let players identify rock types by sight

questions.question: Can the player visually distinguish between different rock strata types (sedimentary vs igneous layers) at a glance?
questions.answer: This feature teaches real science through gameplay — the core educational mechanic.

questions.question: Would a close-up screenshot of stratified canyon walls showing distinct color bands be visually striking enough for Steam marketing?
questions.answer: This feature generates shareable moments and press coverage. Differentiator from competitors.

questions.question: Do strata layers have realistic thickness variation, color transitions, and erosion patterns that make the canyon feel geologically ancient?
questions.answer: This feature makes the universe feel real and alive through physical accuracy.

questions.question: Can strata materials be authored using existing UE5 landscape layer blends and material instances without requiring custom HLSL shaders?
questions.answer: Can be implemented with existing UE5 tools and Python modules. No pipeline blockers.

questions.question: Does strata visualization reuse the existing splat-rendering pipeline in core/matter_gpu.py, or does it require new rendering infrastructure?
questions.answer: Built on existing Chimera infrastructure. No new toolchain dependencies.

questions.question: Are strata layer materials compatible with UE5.8s virtual texture system without requiring workarounds for layer count limits?
questions.answer: Works in UE5.8 without engine modifications. Standard features.

questions.answer: Minimal performance impact. Well within 30fps target on RTX 3060.

questions.question: Is there a pattern-overlay or tooltip alternative so colorblind players can still distinguish strata layers?

questions.answer: Audio design deferred to v2. v1 uses text-only feedback.
